GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. raced away in Straight # much too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding settling in the lead, rider stated that in the previous runs when obtaining cover on the mare, Highland Dancer failed to travel comfortable amongst runners. Having ridden her mount in all past starts she felt that last preparation her mount travelled better when leading. Although the instructions today were not to lead outright, with the increase in distance and a favourable barrier she began more positive to obtain a forward position.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & caught Mid Field Four Wide No Cover (4L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Five Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 200m & only held ground late. # Wide & faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover until passing the 600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, battled on well but never threatening # disappointing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that the mare, which was resuming after a long break without having had a barrier trial, came under pressure from the 600m to hold its position. She said that Highland Dancer then took some time to respond, however closed off satisfactorily over the final 200m and performed as though it will be better suited over a longer distance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to a half length Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 1 length turning, Headed 180m but kept battling to post # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Steadied after shifting out and becoming awkwardly placed on heels over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out . Niggled to recover & raced Mid Field Two Wide (3L from lead) early . Improved 1 length midrace & pushed flat quicken 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & ground home steadily Two Wide In last 150m. # Sound for further.
